color_order.docs:
Should be one of `bgr` (default) or `rgb`.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

blue.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Exactly 5 pins for the blue databits, listed from least to most significant bit.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

green.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Exactly 6 pins for the green databits, listed from least to most significant bit.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

red.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: Exactly 5 pins for the red databits, listed from least to most significant bit.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

data_pins.docs:
A list of pins used for the databus. Specified in 3 groups.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

de_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The DE pin.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

height.docs:
**int**: Specifies height of display in pixels.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

offset_height.docs:
**int**: Specify an offset for the y-direction of the display. Default is 0.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

offset_width.docs:
**int**: Specify an offset for the x-direction of the display, typically used when an LCD is smaller than the maximum supported by the driver chip. Default is 0

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

width.docs:
**int**: Specifies width of display.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

dimensions.docs:
Dimensions of the screen, specified either as *width* **x** *height* (e.g `320x240`) or with separate config keys.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

hsync_back_porch.docs:
**int**: The horizontal back porch length.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

hsync_front_porch.docs:
**int**: The horizontal front porch length.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

hsync_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The Horizontal sync pin.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

hsync_pulse_width.docs:
**int**: The horizontal sync pulse width.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: Manually specify the ID used for code generation.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

init_sequence.docs:
**A list of byte arrays**: Specifies the init sequence for the display. Predefined boards have a default init sequence, which can be overridden. A custom board can specify the init sequence using this variable (RPI displays should provide an empty sequence in which case the SPI bus is not required.)

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

invert_colors.docs:
Inverts the display colors, (white becomes black.) Defaults to false.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

pclk_frequency.docs:
Set the pixel clock speed. Default is 8MHz.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

pclk_inverted.docs:
**bool**: If the pclk is active negative (default is True)

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

pclk_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The PCLK pin.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

pixel_mode.docs:
**string**: Set the pixel mode of the RGB bus interface - one of `16bit` (default) or `18bit`.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

reset_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The RESET pin.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

transform.docs:
Transform the display presentation using hardware. This is typically used only to correct for displays that have x or y drivers wired backwards. To rotate the display the `rotation` option is preferred - it will automatically use hardware transform if possible. The default values for the `mirror_x` and `mirror_y` options are model dependent. For the `CUSTOM` model, use of `transform: disabled` will prevent a `rotation` being translated to a hardware transform.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

vsync_back_porch.docs:
**int**: The vertical back porch length.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

vsync_front_porch.docs:
**int**: The vertical front porch length.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

vsync_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The Vertical sync pin.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

vsync_pulse_width.docs:
**int**: The vertical sync pulse width.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

rotation.docs:
Rotate the display presentation in software. Choose one of `0°`, `90°`, `180°`, or `270°`. This option cannot be used with `transform`.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

update_interval.docs:
**[Time](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#time)**: The interval to re-draw the screen. Defaults to `5s`.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

lambda.docs:
**[lambda](https://esphome.io/automations/templates#config-lambda)**: The lambda to use for rendering the content on the display. See [Display Rendering Engine](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-engine) for more information.

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*

pages.docs:
**list**: Show pages instead of a single lambda. See [Display Pages](https://esphome.io/components/display#display-pages).

*See also: [MIPI RGB Display Driver](https://esphome.io/components/display/mipi_rgb#configuration-options)*
